'''Sathel''' was a [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Pureblood]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Overseer (Sith)|Overseer]] of the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
